units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:4">Kel. XXVI, 4</cite> (<he>צְרוּרוֹת</he>) <he>צ׳ שעה</he> if they are tied up with a temporary knot; <he>צ׳ עילם</he> with a permanent knot; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 6:3:4">Y. Kil. VI, 30ᶜ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 6:3:4">Ib.</cite> <he>צ׳ עולם צריך חיתיך צ׳ וכ׳</he> a permanent knot requires cutting through (to be opened); a temporary knot does not &c.

senses.gloss: bundle, bag. Kel. l. c. 2 צ׳ המרגלית a piece of leather in which jewels are bound up; צ׳ המעות in which money is bound up; Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 3.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20:9">Ex. R. s. 20</cite>; a. fr.
